svg.title: Hello KJ: kjct0s_
svg.desc: Two hands drawn in dots reach toward each other while Hello World appears. Their index fingers extend and touch, and a green spark bursts. The sparks fly into the shape of the handle kjct0s_, which lights up as an extruded 3D wordmark while the hands relax and withdraw, followed by the words Hello KJ. It plays once, in about six seconds, and holds. Without animation, the handle and caption are visible immediately.
